top_signals.title: Lufthansa Predicts Challenging Year With Oil, Fleet Issues
top_signals.summary: Deutsche Lufthansa AG Chief Executive Officer Carsten Spohr predicted another year of financial and operational challenges ranging from uncertain aircraft deliveries to high oil prices and cost pressure at home that will force the airline to sharpen efficiencies.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Angola Raises $224 Million From Standard Bank Unit Stake Sale
top_signals.summary: Angola raised 208.5 billion kwanzas ($224 million) from the sale of a 34% stake Standard Bank Group Ltd.’s local unit, with investor demand almost double the shares offered and Africa’s biggest lender boosting its controlling interest in the lender.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Nvidia unveils AI safety platform to rein in ‘rogue’ AI agents
top_signals.summary: The launch comes after several AI agents breached their testing environments this year, adding to calls for companies to slow the development of autonomous AI systems.
